init.title: BMS Intercom settings
init.description: The browser microphone only works over HTTPS. The integration starts a local HTTPS endpoint on a separate port automatically — usually no change needed. Set the port to 0 to disable it when you run your own reverse proxy on 8443 (see docs/local-https.md), or set an external HTTPS address (e.g. Nabu Casa).
